task_instantiation:
For each experimentally distinct chemical reaction in the text, extract one record. Include successful reactions, failed reactions (yield 0 or 'no reaction'), and trace/low-yield outcomes.

DO NOT extract records for:
- Biological assays where the readout is activity, binding affinity, IC50, or cell viability — not a chemical product
- Text that ONLY contains product characterization (NMR, MS, mp, elemental analysis) without describing how the product was made. If a paragraph only says "compound X was obtained as a white solid (72% yield), mp 168-170°C, ¹H NMR..." but does not say what it was made FROM or HOW, do NOT extract it.
- Vague pathway descriptions or metabolic transformations described without specific experimental conditions
- Physical processes: crystallization, dissolution, extraction, chromatographic separation
- Text that only discusses or cites reactions from other papers without providing its own experimental detail

DO extract:
- Synthetic reactions with defined reactants, products, and conditions
- Enzymatic/biocatalytic reactions with specific substrates and products
- Derivatization reactions (silylation, acetylation) even if done for analytical purposes
- Failed reactions or decomposition outcomes (use outcome_status appropriately)

DO NOT extract from review/discussion sections that describe reactions performed by other groups. Only extract if THIS paper performed the reaction.

QUALITY RULES for high-quality extractions:
- Use the most specific product name available. If the text says 'compound 10 (3,4,5-trimethoxyaniline)', use '3,4,5-trimethoxyaniline' as the product name, not 'compound 10'.
- Never collapse multiple reactions into one record. If the text says 'compounds 11 and 12 were reduced', create two separate extraction records.
- Do NOT re-state conditions from a different paragraph. If this step says 'prepared similarly', only include the conditions explicitly stated here.
- If both a compound number AND a chemical name are given, ALWAYS use the chemical name.

COMPLETENESS — before extracting a record, verify you can fill at least:
- product (required — always fill this)
- reactants (strongly preferred — if the text says what the product was made from, include it; if the text only gives the product name and yield with no procedure, set needs_more_context=true)
- At least ONE condition (temperature, solvent, catalyst, reagent, or reaction_time)
If the text only gives a product name and yield with no procedure or conditions, this is likely a characterization entry — do NOT extract it.

Compound naming — write each compound name exactly as given in the paper. If an IUPAC systematic name is given, prefer it over common names or aliases. If only a label is used (e.g., '3a', 'compound 12'), include the qualifier ('compound 3a'). In the extracted fields, write compound names only — do not attempt to generate SMILES strings.

global_identifier — Copy the global_identifier ONLY from an SM annotation whose surface forms include your exact product name. If no SM annotation matches the product you extracted, set global_identifier to null. A wrong global_identifier is worse than null — do NOT guess from nearby or loosely related annotations.

Reactants: list ALL substrates whose atoms are incorporated into the product, comma-separated.
Reagents: all other reaction participants not in reactants/catalyst/solvent — bases (K2CO3, Et3N, NaH), stoichiometric reagents (NaBH4, mCPBA, DIBAL-H), ligands (XPhos, BINAP), additives (TBAI, molecular sieves). Comma-separated.
Catalyst: transition-metal catalysts (Pd(PPh3)4, Pd/C, CuI), Lewis acids (TiCl4, BF3·Et2O, AlCl3), Brønsted acid catalysts (PPTS, p-TsOH), phase-transfer catalysts, organocatalysts. Include metal + ligand as one entry if reported together.
Solvent: reaction solvents only (not workup/purification), comma-separated.
Outcome status: 'success' if product obtained, 'failed' if yield 0% or 'no reaction' stated, 'trace' if only trace product, 'decomposition' if starting material decomposed. Null if unclear.

Yield — CRITICAL distinctions:
- yield_percent MUST be a percentage (0-100), not a mass in grams or milligrams. If the text says "gave 7.8 g of product", do NOT put 7.8 as yield_percent — leave it null and put "7.8 g isolated" in setup_and_notes.
- Conversion rate is NOT yield. If the text says ">95% conversion", do NOT use 95 as yield_percent. Only use yield_percent for explicitly stated isolated/analytical yields.
- "Essentially pure" or "quantitative" → use yield_type="quantitative", yield_percent=null unless a specific number is given.

Role assignments:
- NaH, NaOH, K2CO3, Et3N, DMAP, pyridine (as base) → these are REAGENTS, not catalysts
- Only use catalyst for species that are recovered/regenerated: Pd catalysts, Lewis acids, enzymes

STRICT FAITHFULNESS — CRITICAL:
Every factual field must come from the SPECIFIC paragraph you cite. Specifically:
- reactants: Only name chemicals EXPLICITLY stated as starting materials. Do NOT infer from chemistry knowledge.
- temperature: Only fill if EXPLICITLY stated for THIS reaction. Do NOT assume room temperature — leave null.
- solvent, reagent, catalyst: Only chemicals EXPLICITLY named for THIS reaction. Do NOT borrow from a general procedure.
- setup_and_notes: Only details EXPLICITLY stated. Do NOT add atmosphere (N2, argon) unless text says so.
Prefer incomplete-but-faithful over complete-but-hallucinated.

schema_spec.name: reaction_type
schema_spec.description: Type of reaction (e.g., Suzuki coupling, hydrogenation, oxidation, reduction, alkylation, acylation, condensation, cycloaddition)

schema_spec.name: reactants
schema_spec.description: All reactants/substrates whose atoms end up in the product, comma-separated. Do NOT include reagents, bases, catalysts, or solvents.

schema_spec.name: product
schema_spec.description: Primary product, name as written in the paper.

schema_spec.name: reagent
schema_spec.description: Bases, stoichiometric reagents, ligands, and additives — comma-separated (e.g., 'K2CO3, XPhos, TBAI'). Not catalysts or solvents. Null if none.

schema_spec.name: catalyst
schema_spec.description: Catalyst or catalytic system (e.g., 'Pd(PPh3)4', '10% Pd/C', 'Grubbs II', 'CuI', 'PPTS', 'TiCl4'). Include Lewis acids, phase-transfer catalysts, and organocatalysts. Only exclude stoichiometric reagents like NaBH4 or bases like K2CO3 (those go in reagent). Null if no catalyst.

schema_spec.name: solvent
schema_spec.description: Reaction solvent(s), comma-separated. Not workup solvents. Null if not reported.

schema_spec.name: yield_percent
schema_spec.description: Yield in percent (0 for failed reactions). Null only if not reported at all.

schema_spec.name: temperature
schema_spec.description: Reaction temperature with units (e.g., '80 °C', 'reflux', 'rt', '-78 °C'). If multiple stages, list the main reaction temperature. Null if not reported.

schema_spec.name: reaction_time
schema_spec.description: Reaction duration (e.g., '2 h', '30 min', 'overnight'). Null if not reported.

schema_spec.name: setup_and_notes
schema_spec.description: Atmosphere (N2, Ar, air), pressure, scale, concentration, equivalents, vessel, and any other relevant conditions not captured above. Null if nothing to add.
